world_audit.note: Group keys consistently bind questions sharing evidence; this is not a claim that future train/held allocation already happened.

findings.title: Authored semantic equality is dropped by source adapter
findings.evidence: grouped-record-candidates-v6b has no semantics.oracle on any of23rows; checkOracle defaults exact. Reversing sol001.correctedClaims or astra-archives-02.clusters preserves the declared set meaning but returned accepted:false, level:exact in actual runtime comparator calls.
findings.required: Emit field-specific unordered paths; preserve ordered chronology/path arrays; judge prose and alternative witnesses against source constraints. Exercise positive permutations and negative omitted/extra/wrong-ID mutations.

findings.title: Scripted reference replay bypasses named stages
findings.evidence: reference() reads files through scoped literal then synthesizer child returns authored expected; no named helper chain is invoked. Passing replay verifies plumbing/typing/readability and oracle transport, not independent oracle truth or semantic topology.
findings.required: Retain independent source-oracle review receipts and live active-parent/stage-contribution checks.

findings.title: Sol authored typed witness/frontier structures weakened
findings.evidence: runtimeTypeFile replaces RelationDecision proposition/relatedIds/witnesses{path,quote} with status:string/evidenceIds/detail, WorkItem candidateIds/requiredProposition with kind, and domain bundle fields with unknown.
findings.required: Preserve useful typed structures or explicitly justify translated contract and measure it; retain exact quote/path witness checks.

findings.title: Astra individual-record literal ID alias is implicit
findings.evidence: Authored local argument is {id,text}; emitted helper item is EvidenceRecord{path,text}, while instructions say pass current item. Grouped presentation omits that authored signature and avoids this particular mismatch.
findings.required: Render explicit id/path adapter or use one record type consistently, then measure changed presentation.

findings.title: Deep forwarding calls do not establish meaningful stage contributions
findings.evidence: Partial grouped v6b /8 buildVoyages forwards unchanged stageFindings; /9 resolveTemporalClaims creates an unused Neuralese literal and forwards unchanged. inventoryLetters and interpretDatePhrase do show meaningful record-local NL chronology interpretation.
findings.required: Inspect sealed trace for distinct named-stage decisions or classify forwarding as plumbing. Do not count unused literals as semantic work.

findings.title: Grouped per-record coverage not yet sealed
findings.evidence: Static types require one finding per record but arrays do not enforce bijection or real IDs. Partial trace preserves record02/03/05/06 paths and correct local relations; results.jsonl was empty at inspection.
findings.required: For each batch enforce exact sourcePath bijection, evidence ID resolution, and grounded unresolved claims; inspect whole24-record result and active call parents.

grouped_variant.presentation: typed folders containing six records in first priority case; not a global fixed-size rule
observed_meaningful_local_relations: V1 loading precedes customs inspection precedes departure
